questions: Sitting in the Yangtze River Delta, this Chinese city served as the capital of various dynasties and republican governments from the 3rd century until 1949, and is now the capital of Jiangsu province. Which city is it?
Nanjing: Capital of Jiangsu, China. It has also been awarded the title of 2008 Habitat Scroll of Honor of China, Special UN Habitat Scroll of Honor Award and National Civilized City.
National Famous Historical and Cultural City

Caliph Mu'awiya I launched the Arabs' first major assault on this Byzantine capital between 674 and 678, seeking a lethal blow as part of the Umayyad expansionist strategy. Which military campaign is this?
Siege of Constantinople (674–678) was besieged by the Arabs in 674-678, in what was the first culmination of the Umayyad Caliphate's expansionist strategy against the Byzantine Empire.
A founder of the group Die Brücke — 'The Bridge' — that helped launch Expressionism, this German painter saw the Nazis brand his work 'degenerate' and sell or destroy over 600 pieces — who is it?
Ernst Ludwig Kirchner: German expressionist painter (1880–1938)

In which country is Circle K?
Circle K: Canada. Circle K Stores, Inc. is a convenience store chain owned by the Canadian multinational operator Alimentation Couche-Tard, Inc., based in Laval, Quebec.
Also called the ratel, this remarkably loose-skinned mammal — able to twist freely inside its own hide — is the largest land member of the weasel family in Africa. What is it?
Honey badger: Species of mammal. The honey badger (Mellivora capensis), also known as the ratel ( or), is a mammal widely distributed across Africa, Southwest Asia, and the Indian subcontinent.

In this 2018 Canadian sci-fi thriller, girls confined at a mysterious school are trained to become 'perfect' young women for families that will supposedly adopt them, until two of them dig for the truth — name the film?
Level 16 is a 2018 Canadian science fiction thriller film written and directed by Danishka Esterhazy.
